hotel_name: Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport

claims.text: The hotel is in the Seaport District near downtown Boston, with unobstructed Boston Harbor waterfront views.

findings.quote: located in the Seaport District neighborhood, near downtown, with unobstructed Boston Harbor waterfront views

claims.text: The hotel is near South Station, the harbor and the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center.

findings.quote: conveniently located near South Station, the harbor, the Thomas Michael Menino Convention and Exhibition Center

claims.text: The hotel is 2.8 miles, about 8 minutes, from Boston Logan International Airport.

findings.quote: 2.8 miles (about 8 minutes) from the Boston Logan International Airport (BOS).

claims.text: Guest rooms have floor-to-ceiling windows with city and harbor views.

findings.quote: guest rooms boasting floor-to-ceiling windows of unrivaled city and harbor views

claims.text: Artist Tower rooms are cozy studio-layout rooms designed for the individual traveler.

findings.quote: Minimalist space with maximum style, this cozy studio layout guestroom was designed for the individual traveler.

claims.text: Breve Spa is the hotel's full-service spa, offering full body treatments, a sauna and a steam room.

findings.quote: Enjoy a $100 treatment credit at our full-service luxury spa, Breve.
Relaxation awaits at Breve Spa, from retail therapy and full body treatments to a sauna and steam room

claims.text: The fitness center has 200 feet of continuous floor-to-ceiling windows that bring in natural light.

findings.quote: Our fitness center also boasts 200 feet of continuous floor to ceiling windows providing vast amounts of natural light

claims.text: Artist Tower guests can borrow fitness gear for free through a partnership with Boston-born apparel company NOBULL.

findings.quote: partnered with Boston-born high-performance fitness apparel company NOBULL to offer our Artist Tower guests access to complimentary gear lending

claims.text: The hotel offers rooftop fitness classes.

findings.quote: Rooftop fitness classes

claims.text: The hotel has an all-day restaurant serving Mediterranean fare.

findings.quote: an on-site all-day dining restaurant offering Mediterranean fare

claims.text: The hotel welcomes medium-size dogs and cats.

findings.quote: is a pet friendly hotel for medium size dogs and cats

claims.text: Conde Nast Traveler lists the hotel as a Readers' Choice Awards winner for 2023, 2024, 2025 and 2026.

findings.quote: Readers' Choice Awards 2023, 2024, 2025, 2026

claims.text: A heated rooftop pool and hot tub on the fifth floor are both open year-round, with views of the city skyline.

findings.quote: The Omni Boston Hotel at the Seaport boasts a fifth-floor heated rooftop pool and hot tub, both open year-round.
The hotel has a rooftop outdoor pool located on the fifth floor with views of the city skyline

claims.text: The suites have floor-to-ceiling windows looking out on Massachusetts Bay and the Seaport skyline.

findings.quote: Our spacious suites celebrate the views of the Massachusetts Bay and Seaport skyline with floor to ceiling windows.

claims.text: Patron Tower rooms have a spacious floor plan with sweeping harbor or Seaport District views.

findings.quote: These sophisticated and warm guestrooms offer a spacious floor plan and feature sweeping harbor or Seaport District views.

claims.text: A rooftop pool bar and grill looks out over the skyline and the water.

findings.quote: a rooftop pool bar and grill with exquisite skyline and water views

claims.text: Pool availability depends on capacity limits, and the pool deck can close for private events.

findings.quote: Availability is contingent on capacity limits and the pool deck is subject to closure for private events.

claims.text: Guests must be at least 21 years old to check in.

findings.quote: Guests must be at least 21 years of age to check-in.

claims.text: Self and valet parking carry a nightly charge.

findings.quote: Self and valet parking with a nightly charge
